searchText: Hello, would like to know who is responsible for the testnet coins allocation of Hoodi testnet. We are running a public node service called 0xRPC https://0xrpc.io, and would like to contribute for Hoodi testnet RPCs and Faucets if possible. <@889157410923614209> Also, could I send you DM regards of sepolia.org? sure sure Operating temporary hoodi endpoint by now https://0xrpc.io/hoodi, could try with `cast block-number -r https://0xrpc.io/hoodi` could you create an issue in the repo linked here and we can take care of the rest? 😄 https://fundingvault.ethpandaops.io/ I know, but would like to know how much allocation is possible for us or could we contact with someone responsible? Because, think that short allocation of funds always have attracted some chinese speculators and hope I could help fixing it Well it depends on the usecase, how you are setting up your faucet, what your checks are and how popular it is. Maybe start small and we can increase it based on performance. Hope the allocation could solve the current issue with testnet faucets, thinking that I would write the faucet from scratch that could spread coins based on daily demand and with fixed daily overall spendings ( so it would be like 1 / n distribution of those who have requested ) so eventually the faucet wouldn't dry up quick nor need to establish some testnet bridges for fair distrubition, etc. But still it would depend on some advice by someone familiar with the matter and coins that my faucet could be allocated with though https://github.com/ethpandaops/fundingvault/issues/64 Done https://github.com/ajsutton/slot-finder/pull/9 <@340345049063882753> wondering if you still support this and can merge/deploy? Merged. Thank you.
